reuse.why: Adds the check as one helper in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, the existing shared module for linking, and every link handler calls it.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only a three-line call with the provider literal is repeated in each of the five already-duplicated link handlers.

placement.why: Link-time rules already live in link.ts and the handlers in accounts/app.ts call into it, so the new assertion follows the existing layering.

scope.why: Touches only the five link handlers, the shared link module and its tests.

maintainability.why: Simple, testable single definition; a new provider handler must still remember to call it since the handlers themselves remain copies.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by all five link*Account handlers in accounts/app.ts
